title: Resume after accept is already checkpointed
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He dispatches a remote coding job on a durable plan; the MechaHarness process dies after acceptance is recorded but before the outcome is reduced. After restart he opens the same durable store, resumes the plan, and verifies the remote job is submitted exactly once with the expected effect state for this crash window. Sibling windows: `fangore_tdr_crash_before_intent`, `fangore_tdr_crash_after_intent_before_call`, `fangore_tdr_crash_after_accept_before_record`, `fangore_tdr_crash_after_accept_recorded`, `fangore_tdr_crash_after_reduce_before_checkpoint`, and `fangore_tdr_crash_after_final_commit`. Complements `fangore_insp_durable_resume` fingerprint refusal. Tracks transactional durable resume[^tdr-req] and MH-PA-05[^insp-pa-05]. He walks product steps (`transactional_resume`) and verifies completion from the structured observation expects on this scenario.
implementation: `SqliteCheckpointStore` + `host_graph_executor` with `ArmedCrashProbe` for coding_job effects. Product CLI verb `transactional_resume` (`mechaharness.cli_transactional_resume`). Unit matrix: `tests/fixtures/transactional_durable_resume/*.json`.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `crash_after_accept_recorded.yaml` drives product verb `transactional_resume` with `crash_location: after_accept_recorded`; hard expects on declared observation keys.
